fields.summary_ko.0: Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Company Limited (TSM) Q3 2026 revenue grew 41.2% year-over-year with EPS up 57.5%, reflecting accelerating AI demand.
fields.summary_ko.1: 2-nanometer technology rapidly adopted at 8% of wafer revenue (up from 3% prior quarter), and FY2026 revenue growth guidance raised to 44% (from prior 40% plus).
fields.summary_ko.2: Capital expenditure expected to increase to $60–64B in 2026–2028, with margin pressure from overseas fab expansion (annual 2% dilution) pressuring net profitability.
